hero.summary: I like owning products end-to-end. I care as much about why and what is being built as how it's being built. I thoroughly enjoy finding solutions to ambiguous problems and building something people actually want to use.

aka.title: aka Utility Player
aka.body: A label my youth soccer coach gave me for being able to play any position on the field.

info.title: Hi! I'm Marissa. I am a product-minded, AI-tinkering, polyglot builder and lifelong learner.
info.summary: I am also a former retail buyer, a futebol player, a marathon runner, and a digital nomad. My path here wasn't a straight line, and that is where my instincts come from. Business school and buying taught me to see a business as a system. Design school taught me to start from the person using the thing. Consulting let me practice both, and building payments at Flexa sharpened the systems side. Now I build things people want, and I build them so the pieces hold together.
